bit string types.name: max resp time
bit string types.description: maximum allowed time before sending a responding report in units of 1/10 second; meaningful only in membership query messages

bit string types.name: checksum
bit string types.description: 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the whole igmp message

bit string types.name: group address
bit string types.description: ip multicast group address; zero for general query, group address for group-specific query, report, or leave

fields.name: max resp time
fields.description: maximum allowed time before sending a responding report in units of 1/10 second; set to zero in non-query messages

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the whole igmp message

fields.name: group address
fields.description: ip multicast group address; zero for general query, group address for group-specific query, report, or leave

helper functions.name: compute checksum
helper functions.description: computes the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the entire igmp message (ip payload).

transform functions.name: checksum
transform functions.description: computes the checksum field from the entire igmp message.
